canonical_gene_rule: frozen-input var_names to var['gene_symbol'], strip, uppercase; duplicate score rows collapsed by arithmetic mean
shared_gene_universe: pairwise shared canonical genes between GSE160269 and GSE188900 full-refit score matrices
source_percentile: within-program rankdata(score)/N; larger value means higher program rank
consensus_rank_aggregation: geometric mean sqrt(percentile_A * percentile_B), with descending minimum source percentile then canonical symbol as deterministic tie-breakers
consensus_prerank_metric: deterministic consensus rank mapped linearly from +1 at rank 1 to -1 at rank N
cohort_member_prerank_metric: full frozen gene-score ordering, ties broken by canonical gene symbol ascending, then mapped linearly from +1 at rank 1 to -1 at rank N
primary_signature: top 50 genes by frozen consensus rank
sensitivity_signature: top 100 genes by frozen consensus rank

gsea.significance: positive NES and BH FDR <0.05 for annotation support

ora.multiple_testing: BH within each RMP x representation x library x signature-size family

figure_term_selection: per RMP and library, rank significant consensus terms by FDR then effect; greedily retain at most two terms whose gene-set Jaccard with already retained terms is <0.5; figures use the union and do not alter full tables
theme_support: for each representation and predeclared theme, maximum capped -log10(FDR) among positive significant GSEA or significant ORA terms whose term text matches the frozen keyword lexicon
competing_theme: second consensus theme is retained in a compound label if significant and its support score is >=75% of the primary theme score
concordance: both primary cohort members support the consensus primary theme at FDR<0.05
discordance: primary cohort top themes differ and both do not support the consensus primary theme
top_gene_coherence: at least 3 consensus Top50 genes occur in significant gene sets assigned to the primary theme

confidence.HIGH: consensus primary theme supported; both cohorts support it and each cohort's top-ranked theme is the same theme; top-gene coherence passes; no competing consensus theme
confidence.MODERATE: consensus theme supported and at least one cohort supports it, or both cohorts support it with a competing theme
confidence.LOW: no supported consensus theme, neither cohort supports the consensus theme, or enrichment remains discordant/diffuse

tier_lock: Phase C evidence tier is immutable; annotation confidence cannot upgrade Tier 2
external_scoring_lock: future datasets use frozen genes with coverage reporting; missing genes are not replaced and outcomes cannot alter signatures
